verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ አተውኩ፡ ቤትየ፡ አግብኡ፡ ሊተ፡ ሐናሃ፡ ብእሲትየ፡ በዕለተ፡ በዓለ፡ ጰንጠቈስጤ፡ ቅድስት፡ ሳብዕ፡ ሰንበት፡ ገብሩ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ ሠናየ፡ ወረፈቁ፡ እብላዕ።
verses.translation: Now when I was come home again, and my wife Anna was restored unto me, with my son Tobias, in the feast of Pentecost, which is the holy feast of the seven weeks, there was a good dinner prepared me; and I sat down to eat.

translations.lxx: Now when I was come home again, and my wife Anna was restored unto me, with my son Tobias, in the feast of Pentecost, which is the holy feast of the seven weeks, there was a good dinner prepared me; and I sat down to eat.
translations.ron: Iar când m-am întors eu la casa mea şi mi-au fost daţi înapoi Ana, femeia mea, şi fiul meu, Tobie, în ziua Cincizecimii, sărbătoarea Săptămânilor, s-a pregătit la mine un prânz bun şi m-am aşezat la masă.
translations.grk: Ὅτε δὲ κατῆλθον εἰς τὸν οἶκόν μου, καὶ ἀπεδόθη μοι Ἄννα ἡ γυνή μου, καὶ Τωβίας ὁ υἱός μου, ἐν τῇ πεντηκοστῇ ἑορτῇ, ἥν ἐστιν ἁγία ἑπτὰ ἑβδομάδων, ἐγενήθη ἄριστον καλόν μοι, καὶ ἀνέπεσα τοῦ φαγεῖν.

verses.geez: ወርእኪ፡ ከመ፡ መስየ፡ በሕቁ፡ ወእቤሎ፡ ለወልድየ፡ ሑር፡ አምጽእ፡ ዘረከብከ፡ እምአኃዊነ፡ ቢጸ፡ ነዳያን፡ እስመ፡ ተዘከርክዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ እጸንሐከ፡ እስከ፡ ትገብእ።
verses.translation: And when I saw abundance of meat, I said to my son, Go and bring what poor man soever thou shalt find out of our brethren, who is mindful of the Lord; and, lo, I tarry for thee.

translations.lxx: And when I saw abundance of meat, I said to my son, Go and bring what poor man soever thou shalt find out of our brethren, who is mindful of the Lord; and, lo, I tarry for thee.
translations.ron: Şi văzând eu multele mâncăruri, am zis către fiul meu: "Mergi şi adu să mănânce cu noi un sărac cu inimă credincioasă, dintre fraţii noştri, robi în Ninive, iar eu te aştept".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐθεασάμην ὄψα πολλά, καὶ εἶπα τῷ υἱῷ μου, βάδισον καὶ ἄγαγε ὃν ἂν εὕρῃς τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἡμῶν ἐνδεῆ, ὃς μέμνηται τοῦ Κυρίου, καὶ ἰδοὺ μένω σε.

verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ ገብአ፡ ወይቤለኒ፡ አባ፡ ረከብኩ፡ አሐደ፡ እምሕዝብ፡ ወግዱፍ፡ በድኑ፡ ውስተ፡ ምሥያጥ።
verses.translation: But he came again, and said, Father, one of our nation is strangled, and is cast out in the marketplace.

translations.lxx: But he came again, and said, Father, one of our nation is strangled, and is cast out in the marketplace.
translations.ron: Şi a venit el şi a zis: "Tată, unul din neamul nostru este sugrumat şi aruncat în piaţă".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλθὼν εἶπε, πάτερ, εἷς ἐκ τοῦ γένους ἡμῶν ἐστραγγαλωμένος ἔῤῥιπται ἐν τῇ ἀγορᾷ.

verses.geez: ወአነሂ፡ ተንሣእኩ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ እጥዓም፡ እክለ፡ ወአባዕክዎ፡ ውስተ፡ አሐዱ፡ ቤት፡ እስከ፡ የዓርብ፡ ፀሐይ።
verses.translation: Then before I had tasted any meat, I started up, and took him up into a room until the going down of the sun.

translations.lxx: Then before I had tasted any meat, I started up, and took him up into a room until the going down of the sun.
translations.ron: Atunci eu, în loc să stau să mănânc, am ieşit repede şi l-am dus într-o casă până după asfinţitul soarelui.
translations.grk: Κᾀγὼ πρινὴ γεύσασθαί με, ἀναπηδήσας ἀνειλόμην αὐτὸν εἴς τι οἴκημα ἕως οὗ ἔδυ ὁ ἥλιος.

verses.geez: ወገባዕኩ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤትየ፡ ወተሐፀብኩ፡ ወበላዕኩ፡ እክልየ፡ በኃዘን።
verses.translation: Then I returned, and washed myself, and ate my meat in heaviness,

translations.lxx: Then I returned, and washed myself, and ate my meat in heaviness,
translations.ron: Şi apoi, întorcându-mă, m-am spălat şi mi-am mâncat pâinea cu întristare.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπιστρέψας ἐλουσάμην, καὶ ἤσθιον τὸν ἄρτον μου ἐν λύπῃ.

verses.geez: ወተዘከርኩ፡ ዘይቤ፡ አሞጽ፡ ይትመየጥ፡ በዓላቲክሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ብካይ።
verses.translation: remembering that prophecy of Amos, as he said, Your feasts shall be turned into mourning, and all your mirth into lamentation.

translations.lxx: remembering that prophecy of Amos, as he said, Your feasts shall be turned into mourning, and all your mirth into lamentation.
translations.ron: Atunci mi-am adus aminte de proorocia lui Amos, care zice: "Prăznuirile voastre se vor preface în jale şi toate cântările voastre în tânguire". Şi am plâns.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐμνήσθην τῆς προφητείας Ἀμὼς, καθὼς εἶπε, στραφήσονται αἱ ἑορταὶ ὑμῶν εἰς πένθος, καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ εὐφροσύναι ὑμῶν εἰς θρῆνον.

verses.geez: ወእምዝ፡ በከይኩ፡ ወሶበ፡ ዓርበ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ሖርኩ፡ ወከረይኩ፡ ወቀበርክዎ።
verses.translation: Therefore I wept: and after the going down of the sun I went and made a grave, and buried him.

translations.lxx: Therefore I wept: and after the going down of the sun I went and made a grave, and buried him.
translations.ron: Iar dacă a asfinţit soarele, m-am dus şi, săpând o groapă, l-am îngropat.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔκλαυσα· καὶ ὅτε ἔδυ ὁ ἥλιος, ᾠχόμην, καὶ ὀρύξας ἔθαψα αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ወሰሐቁ፡ ላዕሌየ፡ ሰብአ፡ ብሔር፡ ወይቤሉ፡ ኢይፈርህኑ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኢይቅትልዎ፡ በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ግብር፡ እስመ፡ ይቀብሮሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ቀተለ፡ ንጉሥ።
verses.translation: But my neighbours mocked me, and said, This man is not yet afraid to be put to death for this matter: who fled away; and yet, lo, he burieth the dead again.

translations.lxx: But my neighbours mocked me, and said, This man is not yet afraid to be put to death for this matter: who fled away; and yet, lo, he burieth the dead again.
translations.ron: Vecinii însă râdeau de mine şi ziceau: "Tot nu se teme că va fi ucis pentru fapta asta; a mai fost fugar şi iată iar se apucă de îngropat morţii".
translations.grk: Καὶ οἱ πλησίον ἐπεγέλων, λέγοντες, οὐκ ἔτι φοβεῖται φονευθῆναι περὶ τοῦ πράγματος τούτου, καὶ ἀπέδρα, καὶ ἰδοὺ πάλιν θάπτει τοὺς νεκρούς.

verses.geez: ወበይእቲ፡ ሌሊት፡ ቤትኩ፡ ስኩብየ፡ ውስተ፡ ዓረፍተ፡ ዓፀድ፡ ወክሡት፡ ገጽየ።
verses.translation: The same night also I returned from the burial, and slept by the wall of my courtyard, being polluted, and my face was uncovered:

translations.lxx: The same night also I returned from the burial, and slept by the wall of my courtyard, being polluted, and my face was uncovered:
translations.ron: Şi chiar în noaptea aceea, după ce m-am întors de la înmormântare, fiind necurat, m-am culcat să dorm afară lingă zidul curţii, cu faţa descoperită.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ νυκτὶ ἀνέλυσα θάψας, καὶ ἐκοιμήθην μεμιαμμένος παρὰ τὸν τοῖχον τῆς αὐλῆς, καὶ τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἀκάλυπτον ἦν.

verses.geez: ወኢያእመርኩ፡ ከመ፡ ቦቱ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ውስተ፡ ዓረፍት፡ ወእንዘ፡ ክሡት፡ ገጽየ፡ አኵስሓ፡ እልክቱ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ውዑየ፡ ውስተ፡ አዕይንትየ፡ ወሖርኩ፡ ኀበ፡ ዓቀብተ፡ ሥራይ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘበቊዓኒ፡ ወአካኪሮስ፡ ይሴስየኒ፡ እስከ፡ አመ፡ ሖርኩ፡ ኤልማድያ፡ ባሕቲትየ።
verses.translation: and I knew not that there were sparrows in the wall, and mine eyes being open, the sparrows muted warm dung into mine eyes, and a whiteness came in mine eyes; and I went to the physicians, but they helped me not: moreover Achiacharus did nourish me, until I went into Elymais.

translations.lxx: and I knew not that there were sparrows in the wall, and mine eyes being open, the sparrows muted warm dung into mine eyes, and a whiteness came in mine eyes; and I went to the physicians, but they helped me not: moreover Achiacharus did nourish me, until I went into Elymais.
translations.ron: Şi n-am băgat de seamă că pe zid erau vrăbii. Şi pe când stam cu ochii deschişi, vrăbiile au lăsat de sus necurăţie în ochii mei şi am făcut albeaţă. Şi m-am dus eu la doctori, pentru îngrijire. Ei mi-au uns ochii cu o alifie, dar am rămas orb. Fraţii au rămas adânc întristaţi de aceasta. Ahiacar a purtat grijă de întreţinerea mea timp de doi ani, înainte de a pleca la Elimaida.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ᾔδειν ὅτι στρουθία ἐν τῷ τοίχῳ ἐστί· καὶ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν μου ἀνεῳγότων, ἀφώδευσαν τὰ στρουθία θερμὸν εἰς τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς μου, καὶ ἐγενήθη λευκώματα ἐν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς μου, καὶ ἐπορεύθην πρὸς ἰατροὺς, καὶ οὐκ ὠφέλησάν με· Ἀχιάχαρος δὲ ἔτρεφέ με ἕως οὗ ἐπορεύθην εἰς τὴν Ἐλυμαΐδα.

verses.translation: And my wife Anna did take women's works to do.

translations.lxx: And my wife Anna did take women's works to do.
translations.ron: Şi atunci Ana, femeia mea, a luat de lucru ca muncitoare, să toarcă lână şi să ţeasă pânză.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἡ γυνή μου Ἄννα ἠριθεύετο ἐν τοῖς γυναικείοις, καὶ ἀπέστελλε τοῖς κυρίοις.

verses.geez: ወለአከት፡ ኀበ፡ አጋዕዝቲሃ፡ ወወሀባሃ፡ እማንቱሂ፡ መሐስዓ፡ ወአምጽአት፡ ኀቤየ።
verses.translation: And when she had sent them home to the owners, they paid her wages, giving her also besides a kid.

translations.lxx: And when she had sent them home to the owners, they paid her wages, giving her also besides a kid.
translations.ron: Ea aducea lucrul făcut şi i se plătea; şi o dată, peste plată, a primit ca dar un ied pentru mâncare.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέδωκαν αὐτῇ καὶ αὐτοὶ τὸν μισθὸν, προσδόντες καὶ ἔριφον.

verses.geez: ወሶበ፡ መጽአት፡ ኀቤየ፡ አኀዘት፡ ትጽራኅ፡ ወእቤላ፡ እምአይቴ፡ ዛቲ፡ መሐስዕ፡ ወለእመ፡ ስረቂዮ፡ አግብኢዮ፡ ለባዕሉ፡ እስመ፡ ኢኮነ፡ ጽድቀ፡ በሊዕ፡ ዘስርቅ።
verses.translation: And when it was in my house, and began to cry, I said unto her, From whence is this kid? is it not stolen? render it to the owners; for it is not lawful to eat any thing that is stolen.

translations.lxx: And when it was in my house, and began to cry, I said unto her, From whence is this kid? is it not stolen? render it to the owners; for it is not lawful to eat any thing that is stolen.
translations.ron: Şi venind acasă, iedul a început să zbiere; şi eu am întrebat pe femeie: "De unde este iedul acesta? Nu cumva este de furat? Dă-l stăpânului lui, căci nu se cuvine să mâncăm de furat".
translations.grk: Ὅτε δὲ ἦλθε πρὸς μέ, ἤρξατο κράζειν· καὶ εἶπα αὐτῇ, πόθεν τὸ ἐρίφιον; μὴ κλεψιμαῖόν ἐστίν; ἀπόδος αὐτὸ τοῖς κυρίοις· οὐ γὰρ θεμιτόν ἐστι φαγεῖν κλεψιμαῖον.

verses.geez: ወትቤለኒ፡ ጸግውኒያ፡ ህየንተ፡ አስብየ፡ ወኢአመንክዋ፡ ወእቤላ፡ አግብኢ፡ ለባዕሉ፡ ወብዙኃ፡ ተገአዝኩ፡ ምስሌሃ፡ ወአውሥአት፡ ወትቤለኒ፡ አይቴ፡ ውእቱ፡ ምጽዋትከ፡ ወጽድቅከ፡ ናሁ፡ ኵሉ፡ ተአውቀ፡ ዘላዕሌከ።
verses.translation: But she replied upon me, It was given for a gift more than the wages. Howbeit I did not believe her, but bade her render it to the owners: and I was abashed at her. But she replied upon me, Where are thine alms and thy righteous deeds? behold, thou and all thy works are known.

translations.lxx: But she replied upon me, It was given for a gift more than the wages. Howbeit I did not believe her, but bade her render it to the owners: and I was abashed at her. But she replied upon me, Where are thine alms and thy righteous deeds? behold, thou and all thy works are known.
translations.ron: Atunci ea mi-a răspuns: "Mi-a fost dăruit peste plată". Şi eu n-am crezut-o şi i-am zis să-l dea stăpânului şi m-am înroşit înaintea ei. Ea însă mi-a răspuns: "Unde-ţi sunt milosteniile şi faptele tale cele bune? Toată lumea ştie ce ţi-au adus".
translations.grk: Ἡ δὲ εἶπε, δῶρον δέδοταί μοι ἐπὶ τῷ μισθῷ· καὶ οὐκ ἐπίστευον αὐτῇ· καὶ ἔλεγον ἀποδιδόναι αὐτὸ τοῖς κυρίοις, καὶ ἠρυθρίων πρὸς αὐτήν· ἡ δὲ ἀποκριθεῖσα εἶπέ μοι, ποῦ εἰσιν αἱ ἐλεημοσύναι σου, καὶ αἱ δικαιοσύναι σου; ἰδοὺ γνωστὰ πάντα μετὰ σοῦ.
